description: Electron game launcher for managing a Steam library and launching games.

uninstaller.script: $uninstaller = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -File -Filter 'Uninstall*.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $uninstaller) { error 'Nightlight Launcher uninstaller was not found.' }; Invoke-ExternalCommand $uninstaller.FullName -ArgumentList '/S' | Out-Null
